title: Give the visual check a home, or stop claiming it
ask: tools/test_visuals.tscn is named in CLAUDE.md's command list and is in no CI workflow and no runnable job in HQ. Work out whether it is a release gate or a developer's tool, and give it a home either way: a headless renderer in CI, or a button on the Engineering page that a person presses before a tag. A check our own docs claim and nothing runs is worse than one we never claimed.
first_action: Run tools/test_visuals.tscn against tools/baseline.png, see what it actually needs, and say which home it should have.
source_message: tools/test_visuals.tscn is named in CLAUDE.md's command list and is in no CI workflow and no runnable job in HQ. Work out whether it is a release gate or a developer's tool, and give it a home either way: a headless renderer in CI, or a button on the Engineering page that a person presses before a tag. A check our own docs claim and nothing runs is worse than one we never claimed.
result: This attempt did not finish — it used all the turns it was given, mid-edit. What it had already changed did land, and the check below is what the chief of staff made of it.

prior_checks.summary: The visual check now has a home as a Run button on the Engineering page under a virtual display, with a regenerated baseline, but nothing in the diff or a reply shows that button was ever pressed and passed, and the release runbook still says a tag is the whole release.

findings.what: No evidence the new job runs green: the worker sent no reply, baseline.png was regenerated (49913 to 44916 bytes) but no run against it is recorded, and I could not execute godot in this sandbox to confirm
findings.fix: Owner runs the visual job twice from the Engineering page on the desktop (or `xvfb-run -a godot --path . res://tools/test_visuals.tscn`) and confirms PASSED both times before this lands; two runs because xvfb's software renderer must be stable run-to-run for a pixel-exact diff to mean anything

findings.what: Runbook contradicts the code: DEPLOY.md says the tag command 'is the whole release', while the goal narrative and the server comment now say press Run on the Engineering page before cutting a tag
findings.fix: Either add the pre-tag step to DEPLOY.md section 3, or better, drop the 'before a tag' framing entirely since the ruling is developer's tool not gate, and a remembered manual step before each release is the defect Daniel said to engineer away

findings.what: The reason for keeping it out of CI is asserted, not measured: 'a GitHub runner would fail commits on rendering drift' was never tried, and the code comment only hedges it as 'not guaranteed'
findings.fix: Reword the narrative to say it is untested on a runner, or spend one CI run with xvfb-run to find out; a foreclosure claim should be tested before it settles a home

findings.what: CLAUDE.md still lists the bare command with 'needs a display' and does not point at the new home, so the next agent reading the command list will not know the button exists
findings.fix: One line: runs under xvfb from the Engineering page's Run button; the bare command is for a developer at a desk

requeued: The visual-regression job it registered in HQ's server was lost to a bug in the drain's own recovery step, which reset a file instead of undoing one patch. The rest of its change landed. Re-queued to finish the job registration.
